capabilities: Send templated prompts to ChatGPT when opening a tagged note
Map tags to prompt templates in settings
Chat with ChatGPT in a sidebar scoped to the active note
Retain conversations for a configurable number of days
disambiguation: Not a general-purpose AI chat panel; prompts are triggered automatically by tags on the opened note.
extras: Storing conversations too long hurts performance (30-day cap); free ChatGPT accounts face API quota limits, so retention length affects quota usage.
problem: Getting useful answers from ChatGPT requires writing good prompts and manually copying note context into a separate chat window, which adds friction to working with notes.

relations.evidence: this plugin will send a prompt to ChatGPT using your template

requires.name: ChatGPT account (free tier has API quota limits)

summary: Sends templated ChatGPT prompts automatically when you open a tagged note, with a per-note chat sidebar for follow-up questions.
